## U27–U33 (added 2026-11-03)

checked every code and redid the mathematics; the demonstrated results were
checked numerically by linear programming and simulation and rechecked.*

**Shape.** U27, "compatibility of tolerance bounds", took the synthesis
([CLAIM-545](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-545.md)) to the joint satisfiability of demands within tolerances.
U28 pointed at the record's sheaf tools. U29 and U30 asked for more. U31
asked to "connect to individuation". U32 asked what the record should add,
and U33 diagnosed the record as "flush with negative assertions and
distinctions" and asked for positive accounts, even as proposals.

**The diagnosis.** Roughly right for the interpretive layer: a crude title
grep finds a negation in 215 of 376 live thesis claims. But the record's
demonstrated layer is mostly positive characterizations already: [CLAIM-153](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md),
[CLAIM-347](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md), [CLAIM-350](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-350.md), [CLAIM-495](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-495.md), [CLAIM-516](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-516.md), [THEORY-1082](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1082.md). A33 cited none of

## The exchange "Organizational Nucleation and SLT" (2026-11-02 to 03, U1–U29), continuing "Assess SDT Coverage": from the record's singular learning theory account and the compatibility complex, through frustration and niche differentiation, new CASE constructions, tolerance as an endorsement criterion, Frankfurt's sense, activation thresholds and psychological flexibility, figures and a sheaf, to a simulation, motivating perspectives and maladaptation; seven claims, two terms, one question and four cases filed, and what was not filed

*2026-11-04 06:43:05*

<!-- inactive-ok-file: TERM-053 — Superseded by ADR-070 (conferral, TERM-103; grant, TERM-101); cited as the term of its time -->

*Reconstructed on 2026-11-04. The source is a ChatGPT share, https://chatgpt.com/share/6aea715b-e488-83ea-8900-c390288262ba, titled "Organizational Nucleation and SLT". It continues "Assess SDT Coverage": its U1 links that exchange's second share, whose U27–U33 were filed on 2026-11-03. It has 29 owner turns, from U1 at about 20:02 UTC on 2026-11-02 to U29 at about 05:35 UTC on 2026-11-03.*

*Seven readers read every turn in full. Each checked every record code the replies cited, redid the mathematics, reran the code where it could, and verified the identifiers of the works named. Each then searched the record again with what the reading surfaced. Codes filed from the exchange carry tmp codes until merge.*

**Gaps in the export.**
- **Two answers are lost.** A11 and A15 show only an opening sentence or paragraph and then "The output of this plugin was redacted". A16 answers U15 point by point. Whether it restates a lost A15 cannot be told.
- **Tool output is redacted throughout.** The replies read the record through a GitHub plugin, so what A actually opened cannot be seen. This affects A2–A3, A6–A10, A13–A14, A16, A19–A20, A25 and A28–A29.
- **The U4 attachments are not in the share.** They are U32–U33 of the earlier exchange, and A4 cites them only by file reference.

**Shape.**
- **U1–U5:** the owner's bridge from recurrent incompatibility to the record's singular learning theory account. The owner corrected A twice, at U2 ("nucleation" is the inquiry) and U5 (one object, not two).
- **U6–U7:** niche differentiation, and the owner's correction of "competition" to frustration.
- **U8–U11:** new CASE constructions, resource-bounded legibility and tolerance, normative axes, and tolerance as endorsement.
- **U12–U16:** the owner's directed tolerances, liking against wanting, Frankfurt's sense, the owner's perspectives model with intervention thresholds, and the crowd cases.
- **U17–U21:** the owner's activation threshold, the U18 correction, the U19 chain, and a plan for figures.
- **U22–U25:** the complex and the will drawn, and the owner's turn to a sheaf.
- **U26–U29:** a synthesis, a simulation, motivating perspectives, and maladaptation.

**What the replies did well.**
- **Concessions.** They took the owner's corrections at once and in substance:
  - A2: "I treated “nucleation” as the physical mechanism rather than the name of the research project".
  - A5: "your objection is right, and my distinction was too sharp".
  - A18: "I made activation depend on instrumental rationality".
- **Cited codes.** These were described correctly nearly everywhere.
- **Hedges.** "stipulated", "illustrative" and "not established" stayed visible to the end.
- **Mathematics.** It held wherever it was checked, with three exceptions:
  - A4's ∀∃ ⇏ ∃∀ needs [CLAIM-535](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-535.md)'s restriction to policies acting on observations;
  - A23's inline SVG draws g_i ≥ 0.6, not 0.4;
  - A25's first script was a SyntaxError.
- **A27's simulation.** It reproduces exactly.

**What they did badly.** The record's usual weakness: held results announced as new.
- **The sheaf account U3 pointed to.** U3 pointed A at [CLAIM-538](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-538.md) and [CLAIM-537](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-537.md), and no reply ever cited them:
  - A9 restated [CLAIM-538](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-538.md)'s cycle certificate as "a particularly elegant consequence";
  - A26 said a cyclic obstruction needs "a torsor and specified transition offsets", which [CLAIM-538](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-538.md) already supplies in tolerance-bounded form.
- **The turns the owner supplied at U4.** [CLAIM-535](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-535.md), [CLAIM-534](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-534.md) and [CLAIM-532](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-532.md) were filed from them, and A4 cited none.
- **The record's own toy models.** [CASE-191](../../record/cases.d/CASE-191.md) (self-formation driven by frustration), [CASE-153](../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md) (the sentry), [CASE-119](../../record/cases.d/CASE-119.md) (the hollow triangle), [CASE-129](../../record/cases.d/CASE-129.md) (the two quiet alarms) and [CLAIM-446](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-446.md) (governance-maintained anxiety) were each re-derived without citation, [CASE-153](../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md) three times.
- **A20's "key mathematical gap".** This is [CLAIM-349](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-349.md)'s ordinal form and [CLAIM-537](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-537.md)'s last clause.
- **Psychological flexibility.** A defined it by redefining the term. The result is [CLAIM-349](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-349.md)'s organizational flexibility, not ACT's sense ([LIT-555](../../record/literature.d/LIT-555.md), [THEORY-050](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-050.md)).
- **Deferred lines treated as live.** A treated organizational authenticity ([TERM-006](../../record/terms.d/TERM-006.md), Deferred) as in force. The owner raised it at U13, and reopening the line is the owner's call.
- **The Frankfurtian sense.** It drifted against [TERM-053](../../record/terms.d/TERM-053.md) from A15 to A29, after the owner had asked at U14 for the two to be kept apart.

## Two findings worth keeping

- **[CLAIM-604](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-604.md)'s "lacks" clause.** The soliton readings report Kerr solitons with an existence window and path dependence under a pump that does not depend on the soliton. Read with Herr et al. ([NOTE-1692](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1692.md)), the soliton's uptake of the pump is parametric and drawn through its own field, so the Kerr case is [CLAIM-604](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-604.md)'s state-dependent uptake from a fixed flux, not supplied repair. The clause was kept, scoped to repair supplied at a rate set by the supply alone. [CLAIM-606](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-606.md) has a note saying its qualification of [CLAIM-604](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-604.md) now rests on the oscillon.
- **[THEORY-1483](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1483.md)'s stability.** A reconstruction of Azam, Devarajan and O'Connell's model from the equations the reading quotes (scratch/formal/azam_stability_check.py) reproduces the steady states, the saddle at the low-aid point and the myopic threshold, but finds the high-aid point an unstable focus with no stable manifold, so not saddle-path stable. The paper's system may differ from the reconstruction. The reading stays Proposed; [CLAIM-602](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-602.md) and [CLAIM-603](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-603.md) cite that stability in prose and should be revisited if the doubt holds.

## About the worklist

A history note that names an objection counts, for the worklist, as the whole objection written in, even when only part of it was conceded. That is how [CLAIM-518](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-518.md) showed as ready. A reviewer caught it by reading the defeater; the script does not.

## Two rulings for later passes

- **When a NOTE is Read.** A NOTE goes to Read when every part its title draws on was read in full, with the quotes checked, and the unread rest does not bear on the title. The history entry lists what was skipped and why. A title that says a source "shows" a theorem draws on the proof, so skipping the proof keeps the NOTE Skimmed (Zhuk, Bulatov).
- **[ADR-074](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-074.md) and part-books.** [ADR-074](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-074.md)'s exclusion of uploads of whole in-copyright books covers an upload of part of one: a chapter of a monograph posted to a document-sharing site is still a piece of the book, not the author's or a course's copy. Pereboom's SciSpace chapter was set aside on this ground.

- **Lake, Salakhutdinov and Tenenbaum, [THEORY-1357](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1357.md).**
  - Narrowed and promoted.
  - The supplementary materials, on Lake's own page, show the record had mis-stated the lesion result. The 11.0% error comes from a token-level lesion, and replacing the learned primitives left error at 3.5%.
- **Chen et al., [THEORY-1334](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1334.md).** Kept. The paper tests correlation and steering, not mediation after finetuning.

### H, operations research

- **Larson and Odoni, [THEORY-1394](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1394.md).**
  - Read from the authors' MIT course edition and promoted.
  - The three-server example was re-derived from the book's inputs and matches to the printed rounding.
  - Two printed travel times are slightly off.
  - One equation image on the site is a duplicate scan, rebuilt from its figure.
- **De Oliveira, de Sá and Martins, [THEORY-1388](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1388.md).**
  - Promoted.
  - A dated note records that the abstract's 21% and 15% gains compare base changes as well as relocation. With bases held, relocation adds 0.5–1.7 points in the deterministic model and −0.3 to +0.1 in the probabilistic one.
- **Guigues, Kleywegt and Nascimento, [THEORY-1412](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1412.md).**
  - Promoted, with its replication condition moved to a QUESTION.
  - The body adds the reviewer's reading of the plotted series, labelled as the reviewer's. On mean allocation cost the policy is lowest at 38 of 46 fleet sizes. On mean response time it is usually fifth of ten.

### I, topology and dynamics

- **Botnan and Lesnick, [THEORY-1422](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1422.md).** Promoted. Example 4.6, the one proof the survey gives, was checked by script.
- **Vipond, [THEORY-1430](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1430.md).**
  - Narrowed to finitely presented modules and promoted.
  - The reader found three slips in the paper's proofs, none of which changes a stated result.
    - Proposition 28's identity swaps w and w⁻¹.
    - Corollary 33's proof inherits that swap.
    - Proposition 36's injectivity proof skips pairs equal in one coordinate.
  - The coordinator was the second checker under [ADR-065](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md) point 5:
    - Definition 25's norm is ‖(wᵢhᵢ)‖∞;
    - substituting h = w⁻¹⊙t gives the corrected identity;
    - finite presentation gives the right-continuity that closes the gap;
    - the script passed, and its controls failed as they should.
- **Freidlin and Wentzell, [THEORY-1366](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1366.md).**
  - Kept: no lawful copy of the book's body.
  - A typeset.io file of unknown extent turned up. The session's permission system refused the request to inspect it. It was not retried and goes in no record file; if it is the book or part of it, [ADR-074](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-074.md) excludes it.

### J, origami and DNA origami

- **Foschi, Hull and Ku, [THEORY-1381](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1381.md).**
  - Narrowed and promoted.
  - The paper has three misprints: two signs in printed Eq. 4, (A3) and (A6).
  - Its claim that non-developable vertices have disconnected modes depends on convention. With fold angles in (−π, π) it holds for the paper's example. Taken mod 2π, the elliptic example and about half of 80 random vertices are connected.
  - The general clause went to a new wide form that records this.
- **Evans, Silverberg and Santangelo, [THEORY-1428](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1428.md).**
  - Narrowed to "the inhomogeneous soft deformations" and promoted.
  - The reviewer's own count, B − 3 floppy modes, is plain Maxwell counting for any triangulated sheet.
  - [NOTE-1587](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1587.md) no longer says the record has nothing on edge states.
- **Cumberworth and Reinhardt, [THEORY-1437](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1437.md).**
  - Narrowed, because the review reports the missing nucleation barrier as a separate result, not a consequence. Then promoted.
  - Its condition went to a new QUESTION refining [QUESTION-410](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-410.md).

### K, the coordinator's leftovers from the twenty-ninth pass

- **[CASE-197](../../record/cases.d/CASE-197.md) promoted.** Its title claims only critical-point results, which its script reproduces. Its neighbourhood results stay labelled as sample minima.
- **[CLAIM-555](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-555.md) held.** It is now unblocked, but it is interpretive and rests on [CASE-197](../../record/cases.d/CASE-197.md), whose adoption is the owner's call. It waits on that assent.
- **Status notes.**
  - [LIT-2138](../../record/literature.d/LIT-2138.md)'s and [LIT-2201](../../record/literature.d/LIT-2201.md)'s status notes no longer say "read in part".
  - [LIT-2131](../../record/literature.d/LIT-2131.md) stays Unavailable under [ADR-053](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-053.md): Europe PMC has no copy, so the publisher's 403 is a paywall.
- **[TERM-107](../../record/terms.d/TERM-107.md), [TERM-110](../../record/terms.d/TERM-110.md) and [TERM-113](../../record/terms.d/TERM-113.md)** say "read in" where their NOTEs went to Read.

## About the pass

- Every narrowing this pass restored a hedge or an attribution, or corrected the record's own mis-statement of a result: Lake's lesion, Lu's R², Foschi's connectedness, Cumberworth's "so that". None found a source wrong about its own central result. The errors found in the sources were slips in proofs and printed equations.
- The second-checker rule ([ADR-065](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md) point 5) was applied by the coordinator re-running each relied-on script and, for Vipond, re-deriving the corrected step by hand. Two of J's scripts, which carry only torus-topology statements, were not second-checked. Each place that cites them says so.

These four, and [TERM-112](../../record/terms.d/TERM-112.md), still say "read Skimmed" or "skimmed".
- **[CLAIM-555](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-555.md),** once the owner rules on [CASE-197](../../record/cases.d/CASE-197.md).
- **Still waiting.** [THEORY-1366](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1366.md) and [THEORY-1334](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1334.md), the new wide forms, and the Proposed readings whose copies were not reachable in the twenty-ninth pass.

U1 at 08:18 UTC on 2026-11-06 to U24 at 00:48 UTC on 2026-11-07, and 52
assistant replies counted as A1–A52 (progress notes included). A browsed
the record on GitHub and the web.*

*The share page was fetched with curl and its embedded conversation
decoded; the session's permission rule for that fetch is the one added in
dmarx/nucleation#421. Seven readers each read a run of turns in full,
checked every record code the replies cited, reran the mathematics, and
searched the record a second time with what the reading surfaced. Codes
filed from the exchange carry tmp codes until merge.*

  paper finds the opposite of what the post recalls.

## The synthesis audit

*Added at the owner's request on 2026-11-07, after the filing, under the synthesis audit protocol
[ADR-075](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md) proposes. The five CLAIMs it filed, and the findings by check, are in
the curation entry's "Syntheses audited".*

Protocol: [ADR-075](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md) (Proposed), the read-and-file skill's step 9b. Source: the exchange
(https://chatgpt.com/share/6aee7a9b-f13c-83e9-a865-6a29c2c3ff7e). Readers' ledgers: S4 (A37), S6
(A45), S7 (A52). Codes are bare; tmp codes are this filing's and Proposed (QUESTION-tmp… are Open).

### 1. Every synthesis, classified and grouped

| turn, section | what it is | class | thesis |
|---|---|---|---|
| A5 (whole), "What I think is the most important synthesis" | executive summary of the record (U2) | descriptive | none; audited §7 |
| A7 (whole), "The resulting philosophical picture" | the account "if the hypotheses were demonstrated" (U3) | supposed | T0 → [CLAIM-610](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-610.md) |
| A9 "The broader synthesis", A12 §11 | the laboratory's method | proposed, held | [CLAIM-616](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-616.md) (the owner's U4); not filed again |
| A14 §11, A16 §8, A18 §12, A20 §8, A20 §10, A22 §11, A25 §11, A27 §8, A29 §11 | possibility-organization account | proposed | T1 → [CLAIM-611](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-611.md) (A29 §11 filed) |
| A32 §12, A34 opening and §10, A36 §8, A37 (whole, "The synthesis in one statement") | historical organizational structuralism | proposed | T2 → [CLAIM-615](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md) (A37 filed) |
| A39 §12, A41 §13–14, A43 §12, A45 §I, §XV, §XVI | meaning, perspective and will in the same account | proposed | T3 → [CLAIM-620](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-620.md) (A45 §XVI filed, A52 §17's clause revisions kept) |
| A47 opening and §9, A50 §11, A52 §1 and §17 | the dispositional reframing | proposed | T4 → the dispositional reframing (A52 §17 filed; later withdrawn) |

**Why five, not one.** Each synthesis restates the earlier ones. The test is the integrating claim:
a version restates it with corrections; a distinct thesis answers a different question from
components the earlier did not integrate.

- **T0 against T1.** T0 integrates the record's held lines: [CLAIM-474](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md)'s partial order, [CLAIM-405](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-405.md),
  [CLAIM-329](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md), will-organization and [CLAIM-545](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-545.md). It claims each level organizes the conditions of the
  one below, under a supposition. T1 integrates the exchange's new formal material (synergetics,
  coordination dynamics, metastability, sheaves). It claims that the locus of persistence is what
  keeps a repertoire realizable. T1 never revises A7, and its voice is proposed, not supposed.
- **T1 against T2.** T1 says what persists. T2 says what makes successive realizations one
  individual: causal transmission with no invariant structure, plural succession, external
  maintenance. A32 §12 opens T2 by correcting T1 ("one important limitation in our previous
  formulation"), and that correction is carried back into [CLAIM-611](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-611.md). Its components are new:
  the owner's U14–U16, [CLAIM-329](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md), [CLAIM-328](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-328.md), [CLAIM-287](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-287.md), [QUESTION-393](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-393.md) and [CLAIM-136](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-136.md). T2 rests on T1.
- **T2 against T3.** T3 adds meaning, perspective and will, and makes a different integrating claim:
  concepts are individuated by T2's criterion, and meaning–will dynamics and individuation condition
  each other. Its components are largely new: [TERM-073](../../record/terms.d/TERM-073.md), [TERM-098](../../record/terms.d/TERM-098.md), [TERM-023](../../record/terms.d/TERM-023.md), [CLAIM-336](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-336.md),
  [CLAIM-330](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md), [CLAIM-402](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-402.md), the owner's U18–U20. T3 rests on T2.
- **T3 against T4.** A52 restates all of T3, so it is also T3's latest restatement; its clause
  revisions are kept in [CLAIM-620](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-620.md). But A52 §17 adds an integrating claim T3 lacks: "And now we
  can see how these are connected through dispositions". It also brings new components:
  [TERM-118](../../record/terms.d/TERM-118.md), [TERM-086](../../record/terms.d/TERM-086.md), [TERM-104](../../record/terms.d/TERM-104.md), [CLAIM-421](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-421.md), [CLAIM-047](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-047.md), [THEORY-670](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-670.md). The protocol foresees a filed
  synthesis that "reframes another": T4 complements T3 and rests on T1 and T2.

The owner's four candidates all pass as distinct (T1–T4); the supposed T0 is a fifth.

## The second share: U25–U28

*Added on 2026-11-07. The owner extended the exchange and shared it again
as https://chatgpt.com/share/6aeea2bc-d280-83e9-ac1f-f6772adf263c
("Branch · Individuation, Possibility, and Disposition"). It is identical
to the first share through A51. A52 lacks only its closing offer, and
U25–U28 (A53–A62, 01:50 to 03:24 UTC on 2026-11-07) are new. Three readers
read the new turns in full, under briefs that carried step 9's ARG rule
and the synthesis audit from the start.*

**Shape.**
- **U25:** the owner asks A to review the whole conversation and propose
  additions to the record. A55 gives a prioritized list. A browsed the
  default branch, so it could not see this filing's entries.

  distinctions". A58 is mostly a survey.
- **U27–U28:** the owner's question about the counter-normativity of a
  self-maintaining system that harms and reproduces the representational

  further".

**What the replies did well.**

  argued by [ARG-075](../../record/arguments.d/ARG-075.md).
- **A58 read the legibility entries rightly** in the main: [TERM-064](../../record/terms.d/TERM-064.md)'s
  stages, [CLAIM-535](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-535.md)'s criterion and example, [CLAIM-523](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-523.md) and [CLAIM-545](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-545.md).

  ([QUESTION-439](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-439.md)), and the amendments to [TERM-019](../../record/terms.d/TERM-019.md), [TERM-086](../../record/terms.d/TERM-086.md), [TERM-098](../../record/terms.d/TERM-098.md),

## A's review of the pull request

*Added on 2026-11-07. The owner pasted ChatGPT's review of the pull
request. It is A's, and the owner accepted items 1–5 and 7 as written and
asked for item 6 to be polished.*

**What it got right.** The curation entry contradicted itself about
whether the syntheses were filed. The counter-corrective disposition had
been identified with a fink, which the diagnostic cannot show. The
answerability claim needed a construction that holds the harm fixed, and
[CASE-229](../../record/cases.d/CASE-229.md) supplies one. The anti-vax case's title asserted what only
A's reports support.

**What was polished.** A's admission threshold, "not exhausted by its
components", was a judgement the filer of a synthesis would tend to make
in its favour. [ADR-075](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md)'s version 2 turns it into a test: state a
case in which every component holds, none of their own defeaters met,
and the integration fails. Applying it, the session filed one synthesis
fewer, and it caught two kinds of failure the audit had not named:
- a defeater that targets a component, not the integration;
- a free parameter that absorbs every case.

A's other process point, that ARGs were being asked for every
illustrative link, was right. The skill now asks for an ARG only where
support is load-bearing or contested.

**What it left open.** Whether reproducing an unavoidable blindness can
be a further wrong. The admission test made the question visible. At
first it was misreported as a disagreement with the owner, on the
strength of a clause a filer had written into the owner's claim (A's
second review).

**Narrowings.** Each dropped clause was a mis-statement of the filing,
not a wider thesis the source asserts, so it goes to a history note only
(README §2, kind 3); each history quotes the old title.

- [THEORY-1587](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1587.md) (Jawaid and Mansuy): "the best-supported carrier" became
  "the best-described candidate carrier", the review's own words.
- [THEORY-1612](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1612.md) (Youssef et al.): "accumulating but preliminary" became the
  weaknesses the authors name; [NOTE-1310](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1310.md)'s body never shows
  "preliminary".
- [THEORY-1627](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1627.md) (Danieli et al.): the .21 total effect belongs to the
  two-item broken-linkages scale, not to its one item.
- [THEORY-1563](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1563.md) (Thorstad): "the arguments offered" for a time of perils
  became the three he examines, leaving aside the one from AI, which he
  sets aside.
- [THEORY-1578](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1578.md) (Stich): the sub-doxastic reply answers the fourth argument,
  not all four.
- [THEORY-1589](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1589.md) (Pinter and Greenwald): allocation favouritism was compared
  for three inductions, not four.
- [THEORY-1611](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1611.md) (Dovidio et al.): the empathy mediation came from the
  common-identity condition of the follow-up study.

**Ties removed.**

- [THEORY-1602](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1602.md) (Dias and Ressler) from [QUESTION-302](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-302.md). The question asks
  what carries a memory through the rebuilding of the nervous system in
  the animal that learned; sensitivity in offspring does not meet it. The
  question's body citation stays.
- [THEORY-1588](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1588.md) (Akerlof and Kranton) from [QUESTION-300](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-300.md). Its identity
  utility is a self-image of conformity, with no motive aimed at another's
  good and no self that includes the group's good.
- [THEORY-1608](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1608.md) (Spears 2021) from [QUESTION-300](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-300.md). Its account is of social
  influence; it holds no result on helping. Its corroboration of [CLAIM-493](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-493.md)
  stays, since the claim's own words need the step from prototypicality to
  influence.

**Rulings worth the owner's eye.**

- [THEORY-1618](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1618.md) (Horsthemke) stays `bears_on` [QUESTION-297](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-297.md), not `answers`.
  Its title holds that Horsthemke argues something, about present methods,
  and over only the germline against ecological and cultural inheritance.
  [QUESTION-297](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-297.md)'s note calling it "the second answer it allows" is the
  record's inference; if the owner wants it in the argument, the vehicle is
  an interpretive CLAIM grounded on [THEORY-1618](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1618.md) that could offer the answer.
- [THEORY-1601](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1601.md) (Levin and Shomrat) is promoted though [NOTE-1283](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1283.md) is
  Skimmed: the NOTE's history says the post was read in full and marked
  Skimmed because it is too thin for a full NOTE.
- [THEORY-1586](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1586.md) (Abramsky and Sadrzadeh) asserts, once Active, that the
  obstruction in their linguistic examples is inconsistency and not
  contextuality in Abramsky and Brandenburger's sense. That is checked
  against [NOTE-644](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-644.md): the paper defines no compatibility condition on
  overlaps.
- [THEORY-1634](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1634.md) (Blackiston et al.) keeps "survived larval molts but not
  metamorphosis" as the authors' report, though [NOTE-1249](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1249.md) rates the null
  in 15 adults weak.
- [THEORY-1574](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1574.md) (Bostrom 2013) keeps `corroborates` [CLAIM-491](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-491.md) as weak
  support, which its body says; [CLAIM-491](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-491.md)'s own note cites it for the
  point.
- The thinnest ties kept on [QUESTION-300](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-300.md) are [THEORY-1598](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1598.md) (Reimer et al.,
  a textbook statement whose words meet the question's "salient
  self-categorization") and [THEORY-1603](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1603.md) (Scheepers and Ellemers, evidence
  by contrast: Tajfel's definition puts caring into social identity).

**Kept Proposed.** [THEORY-1631](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1631.md) (Sturesteps): the thesis was skimmed. Its
note says so.

**What is left.** The NOTE, QUESTION and LIT defects the reviewers met
outside their files go to the defect sweep of the same day. [QUESTION-300](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-300.md)
and [CLAIM-493](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-493.md)'s converses are the repair bot's.
